78883.subject: World's Launch Theater
78883.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

———————————————————————————

GM and happy Thursday!

Hunter Biden picked yesterday to launch a memecoin named after the laptop, and traders ran it to a twelve-figure FDV and back inside two hours. 

We break down the launch below, then dig into [World.xyz](https://World.xyz) opening its standalone prediction market platform to a claimed 1M-person waitlist.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

Hunter Biden's LAPTOP hit Base on schedule Wednesday morning and produced the fastest round trip of the year. Snipers and click traders [pushed](https://x.com/DegenerateNews/status/2097663789852238177) the token's FDV past $110B in the first hour on about $7M of pool liquidity before the price collapsed >99% within two hours of launch, sitting at a $823M FDV this morning. Biden [pitched](https://x.com/HunterBiden/status/2097448481808080911) the launch as redemption economics, saying 20% of supply goes to an airdrop that includes wallets that lost money on TRUMP, while 30% sits behind burn-or-charity milestone triggers. 

The airdrop fed the dump: subscribers to Biden's Substack could claim 4,276 tokens each, and traders tracking the claims counted $1.8M claimed and sold within hours of launch. Biden [responded](https://x.com/HunterBiden/status/2097790749861638547) Wednesday evening, blaming thin liquidity and predatory snipers while claiming the team's allocation stayed locked and nobody on his side sold. 

A Community Note attached to the post counters that a project multisig received 100M tokens, 10% of supply, before launch and has sold about 42.5M of them, citing onchain data reported by Quartz and CoinDesk. Matt Casto of CMT Digital called the setup "[a terrible snipe environment](https://x.com/mcasto_/status/2097670755840413702)" as trading opened, pointing to hundreds of decoy LAPTOP pairs and a contract address everyone already knew. Aerodrome [listed](https://x.com/aeroxyz/status/2097656354106425379) a LAPTOP/USDC pool with 4M LAPTOP in incentives within the first hour of trading.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c73225bd-b881-4f9a-b93e-30bccd38317f/image.png?t=1789041941)
Caption: 

Separately on Base, traders pushed VVV to a new all-time high near $28 on Wednesday morning before the token settled around $24, up 46% on the week and 102% over the past month. The rally leans on a tightening supply story. Venice executed its largest [discretionary burn](https://x.com/AskVenice/status/20973625867

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Markets are in a cautious holding pattern: Bitcoin sits near $78K, pinned below $80K as traders brace for Friday's CPI print and next week's Fed decision — even as adoption headlines from PayPal, MetaMask and real-world tokenization quietly stack up. 🦊 Consensys Splits in Two as MetaMask Goes Independent Consensys will separate into two independent companies by the end of 2026. The existing entity rebrands as MetaMask under Joe Lubin, focused on consumer self-custody finance, while a newly formed firm keeps the Consensys name to run Linea and institutional infrastructure. Read full story 🇩🇪 Germany Moves to Scrap Its Tax-Free Bitcoin Perk Germany's finance ministry drafted a bill applying a flat 25% tax on crypto gains, ending the rule that made coins held over a year tax-free. It would target assets bought from 2027, with older holdings grandfathered — though it still needs parliamentary approval. More details 🏛️ Bessent Presses the Senate to Advance the Clarity Act Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged senators to move on the crypto market-structure bill, warning that inaction would signal America is unwilling to lead on digital assets. A cloture vote on the motion to proceed is scheduled for September 15 and needs 60 votes. Read more 💵 PayPal Turns Its Stablecoin Into a Platform PayPal, M0 and MoonPay launched PYUSDx, letting any business issue a custom stablecoin backed 1:1 by PYUSD. Launch partners Saturn, Concrete and Cap have already processed more than $100 million, repositioning PayPal as stablecoin infrastructure rather than a single coin. See details 🔮 World Opens Its Solana Prediction Market to 1M Users World rolled out its standalone, non-custodial prediction market on Solana to more than a million waitlisted users, with Chainlink powering data and settlement. Coverage spans NFL games, soccer, the 2026 US midterms and Fed decisions, with over 150,000 markets already created. Full story 🌾 India's Grain Giant Puts $2B of Loans Onchain Arya.ag, India's largest agricultural warehousing firm, is tokenizing grain deposits, warehouse receipts and loan status on an Avalanche-based ledger built with Ava Labs. The goal is to give lenders one verifiable view of the collateral behind farm credit across a $2 billion crop network.
